evidence.title: GitHub - shadcnstore/shadcn-dashboard-landing-template: Accelerate your development with a sleek, open-source admin dashboard and landing page built on Vite-React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn/UI

name: ShadCN Dashboard + Landing Page Template
summary: Open-source shadcn/ui dashboard and landing page template with 30+ pages, in both Vite React and Next.js versions.
description: A free template shipping two complete projects: an admin dashboard with 30+ pages (two dashboard variants, mail, tasks, chat, calendar and users apps, authentication, settings and error pages) and a marketing landing page (hero, about, features, stats, logo carousel, team, testimonials, blog, pricing, FAQ, contact, CTA, navigation, footer). Both come in Vite + React 19 and Next.js 16 versions, with a live theme customizer powered by tweakcn and seven built-in themes; 2.0 runs on Base UI instead of Radix UI.
contains: admin dashboard with 30+ pages and 2 dashboard variants
apps: mail, tasks, chat, calendar, users
data tables with sorting, filtering and pagination
landing page: hero, features, stats, team, testimonials, blog, pricing, FAQ, contact, CTA, footer
live theme customizer (tweakcn) with 7 built-in themes
auth, settings and error pages (404, 401, 403, 500, maintenance)
